links.outcome: Prospective performance of the implemented model on live EHR data versus retrospective 58-feature model
links.effect: Prospective 32-feature model AUROC 0.874 (95% CI 0.860-0.887) versus 0.925 (95% CI 0.900-0.947) for the 58-feature model; AUCPR 0.111.
links.quote: The AUROC for the prospectively implemented model was 0.874 (95% confidence interval [CI] 0.860-0.887), and the AUCPR was 0.111.

links.outcome: Comparison of the ML model against ASA physical status baseline
links.effect: ML model AUROC 0.874 vs ASA physical status AUROC 0.814 (95% CI 0.802-0.827); AUCPR 0.111 vs 0.103.
links.quote: By comparison, the AUROC for the 58-feature model was 0.925 (95% CI 0.900-0.947), and for ASA physical status the AUROC was 0.814 (95% CI 0.802-0.827) and the AUCPR was 0.103.

screen.reason: Prospective validation and EHR deployment of a real-time postoperative mortality risk prediction tool, evaluating model performance and feasibility without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
